change_rationale: Run 05 independently confirmed five distinct evidence findings omitted or combined in v4: production-layout security audits, physical failure-path automation, contract consumer replay, Compose negative-path proof, and credential-parser rejection. RF-027 is narrowed to scanner evidence and RF-038 records parser rejection separately so adjudication remains one-to-one. Run 05 stays frozen and failed; a fresh blind rerun is required with disputed and high-risk historical cases escalated to the strong tier.

findings.summary: The fixture brief omits schema/public-contract classification and named consumer compatibility evidence.
Missing sensor-health evidence can leave a state allowed instead of blocked.
The diff changes production estimator cadence outside the approved brief without availability classification or evidence.
The supplied evidence does not cover the diff's data-loss migration and isolated restore requirements.
Application services silently use a built-in database URL when DATABASE_URL is absent.
The application-owned backup invokes a global-object dump that its least-privilege database role cannot perform.
The declared security risk lacks inspectable security-scan and dependency-audit results.
Representative local-model acceptance evidence is missing for changed runtime/output-bound behavior.
The validator accepts long output containing reasoning or prompt-discussion text before the required marker.
The brief omits risk classification for changed persisted/public story data.
An already-applied migration is edited to change the persisted story column instead of adding a forward migration.
Private environment context can be echoed into the persisted and public story without a semantic privacy boundary.
Control calls the hardware adapter without Guardrails or Executor.
Restart loses acknowledgement state and repeats a physical command.
Missing timestamps are treated as fresh control state.
Required supervised hardware and restart-rehearsal evidence is NOT RUN.
Generic unit-test evidence omits required physical-action failure-path simulations.
A 0..1 moisture ratio is compared with a percent threshold.
Expected fixture was changed to normalize an incompatible payload.
The test mocks ingestion while the HTTP path still rejects the payload.
The contract change lacks required edge compatibility and manual canary evidence.
Generic schema/API evidence omits old/current transport and downstream consumer replay.
APP_IMAGE silently defaults to latest instead of failing clearly.
The rehearsal profile activates external cloud export.
Required isolated rehearsal, rollback and zero-export evidence is missing.
Required security and dependency-audit evidence is missing.
Generic Compose evidence does not prove required-variable failure or rehearsal export exclusion.
Secret-like private-key material is committed in a fixture.
Required secret-scanner evidence is missing.
Required real credential-parser rejection evidence is missing.
Raw model text is trusted and published without parsing or validation.
Supplied tests omit required malformed/reasoning/timeout/unavailable/oversized/privacy cases.
Representative local-model acceptance evidence is incorrectly declared not applicable for changed output mapping.
An open temporary file is unlinked before close and fails on Windows.
Required rollback rehearsal is NOT RUN despite green CI.
The runbook documents a configuration default that differs from code.
Linux-only CI evidence does not cover the required Windows temporary-file regression path.
